text.content:
Session 1 opens here: the party's last night in Daggerford before the trek south. Introductions, provisioning, and the map on the table.

Read aloud — the opening scene

The Silver Gauntlet is loud tonight. Caravan drivers argue tolls by the fire; off-duty militia dice for coppers at the rim of the great gauntlet set into the flagstones of the floor, its pale stone knuckles rubbed mirror-bright by a hundred years of departing hands. Out past the walls, the ferry bell rings the last crossing of the day.

Your table is quieter. Between the mugs lies the thing that brought you together: the map. Four ruins in the wild country south. One relic — the Broken Heart — shattered into four shards. And one small village dead-center of it all, the only roof and market for days: Greenrest.

Dawn comes early. Whatever you still need — rope, rations, a sharper blade, a last word with whoever you're leaving behind — tonight is the night. Tomorrow the Trade Way runs south, and east off its far miles waits the Misty Forest, which has always belonged to the fey and the fog.

Running the scene

  • Introductions. Around the table: how each PC ended up in Daggerford, why they're chasing the Broken Heart, and their thread to another PC (prepped from the player briefing).
  • Last-chance shopping. Anything from the equipment chapter at book prices. Make it explicit: this is the LAST reliable resupply — Greenrest is a village, not a town.
  • Hand over the props. The Treasure Map to the Broken Heart and The Sword Coast journals are the player-facing maps; the briefing journal covers what they already know.
  • Table talk. Let them overhear: the Misty Forest is fey country and always has been; parties ride south chasing relic rumors and few send word back; the valley around Greenrest is the greenest land anyone's seen. All true, none of it the secret.

Don't foreshadow the Dreamer. Nothing in Daggerford knows Greenrest's truth. The dread starts — quietly — only once they're IN the valley; tonight should feel warm, ordinary, and a little exciting. The worst thing in the room is a bar tab.

Behind the bar: use @UUID[Actor.FWc6oBk3aFxZ2qBv]{Dellan the Bartender} or @UUID[Actor.RNtmFBkzt7CPUFNk]{Osric the Bartender} as the Gauntlet's keeper (keep the other for Greenrest's inn), and dress the room from the Daggerford folder: @UUID[Actor.aQhstefd4FTCRbK2]{Torvald the Sellsword}, @UUID[Actor.uBuAvgJGzPQ2FBsQ]{Faelar the Sorcerer}, @UUID[Actor.4x7BfYLnPTGzoVHw]{Tessa the Drummer} and @UUID[Actor.vLWqYoAm2CvTqVXD]{Lyra the Musician} make a fine adventurers'-tavern crowd.

Transition out: when they're done, cut to dawn — a last stoop to rub the Gauntlet's knuckles on the way out the door, the south gate, and the long road south (switch to the Sword Coast scene).
